title: Doc comments in libsufr name a module that does not exist and describe the wrong method
body:
Two stale doc texts.

- The comment on `SequenceFileData` (`libsufr/src/types.rs:266`) links `libsufr::utils::read_sequence_file`. The module is `util`.
- The doc comment on `SuffixArray::list` (`libsufr/src/suffix_array.rs`, ending at line 238) is a copy of the `extract` doc.

Seen by reading the code in the survey.
close_reason: Fixed by ad1a659. At cff9fb6 no `utils::` text remains in `libsufr/src`, and the `SuffixArray::list` doc is gone because `list` now lives in the CLI (`sufr/src/lib.rs:405`).

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: Half present on dev at 657e16d. The `utils::` link is gone: `types.rs:266` links `crate::read_sequence_file`. The `SuffixArray::list` doc at `libsufr/src/suffix_array.rs:196` still opens with the `extract` doc's "Extract the suffixes matching given queries".
